in_marathi.name: Munish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Munish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Munish is derived from Sanskrit words 'muni' (wise) and 'ish' (protector). It signifies a wise protector or a guardian who is filled with wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Munis are ascetics or sages who have gained immense wisdom through meditation and spiritual practices. The name Munish is believed to bestow wisdom and the ability to protect and guide.
